quests.title: Wishes Contended, Fortunes Won

dialogue.t: Step right up and take a look! Play a round of "Wishes Contended, Fortunes Won" and ring in a year of good luck!
Oh, it's the brand new mini-game released by the Ministry of Civil Affairs.
With the "Prosperity Pouch" and "Charm Coins," just a little skill is all it takes to bring you luck and good fortune!
If you'd like to try them and bring yourself some good fortune, you're always welcome here!

quests.description: You come across a strange stall in Liyue Harbor…
